title: High Molecular Weight DNA Extraction from Algae Using SoCK Method
author: Benoît Vacherie
materials: Lysis Buffer Reagents Final Concentration 1 Tris HCl ph8 100 mM 2 EDTA 20 mM 3 CTAB 2 % 4 NaCl 1.4 M 5 PEG 8000 1 % 6 H2O Qsp 20 ml

steps.title: Prepare Sorbitol pre‑wash buffer
steps.instruction: Make 100 ml Sorbitol pre‑wash buffer containing 100 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8, 5 mM EDTA, 700 mM sorbitol, 1 % (w/v) PVP‑40, and bring to volume with water. Store at 4 °C (up to 6 months).

steps.title: Chill mortar and pestle
steps.instruction: Place the mortar on ice and cool the mortar and pestle with liquid nitrogen until bubbling stops.

steps.title: Grind frozen sample
steps.instruction: Add 1 g frozen algae to the chilled mortar and grind to a fine powder (≈2 min) without adding liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: First sorbitol wash
steps.instruction: Transfer the powder to a 50 ml tube, add 20 ml Sorbitol pre‑wash buffer, add 20 µl 2‑Mercaptoethanol, vortex 5 s, centrifuge 5 min at 5000 × g, room temperature, low deceleration (Acc 9/Dec 7), and carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Second sorbitol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the first wash: add 20 ml Sorbitol pre‑wash buffer, add 20 µl 2‑Mercaptoethanol, vortex 5 s, centrifuge 5 min at 5000 × g, room temperature, low deceleration (Acc 9/Dec 7), and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Lyse cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 20 ml Lysis buffer, add 50 µl 2‑Mercaptoethanol and 40 µl RNase A (100 mg ml⁻¹), vortex 5 s, then incubate 1 h at 65 °C with gentle agitation (≈300 rpm).

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 10 min at 8500 × g, 4 °C, low deceleration (Acc 9/Dec 7); gently transfer the supernatant to a new 50 ml tube.

steps.title: Phase separation
steps.instruction: To the supernatant add 0.1 vol absolute ethanol, 0.25 vol 3 M potassium acetate, and 1 vol chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1); vortex 5 s; incubate 20 min at –20 °C; centrifuge 20 min at 8500 × g, 4 °C, low deceleration (Acc 9/Dec 7); transfer the aqueous phase to a new 50 ml tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 0.8 vol isopropanol, 0.1 vol 3 M sodium acetate, and 0.2 % 2‑Mercaptoethanol; mix gently by inverting 10 times; incubate 1 h at –20 °C; centrifuge 20 min at 8500 × g, 4 °C, low deceleration (Acc 9/Dec 7).

steps.title: Wash DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, gently resuspend the pellet in 1 ml cold 70 % ethanol, and transfer the suspension to a 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Remove ethanol and dry
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 10 min at 5000 × g, 4 °C, low deceleration (Acc 9/Dec 7); discard the supernatant; air‑dry the pellet at room temperature for ~10 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Add 50–100 µl 1× TE buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA); incubate 2 h at 55 °C (or overnight at room temperature) to fully dissolve DNA.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure concentration with a Qubit DNA HS assay, assess purity with a Nanodrop (260/280 and 260/230 ratios), and evaluate fragment size distribution using a Tapestation or Femto Pulse.

steps.title: Optional size selection
steps.instruction: If needed, deplete short fragments using SRE size‑selection kits (XS, S, or XL) according to the DNA concentration and length profile.
